method.value: Four pseudo-slits; Gaussian components fitted to spectra (2 for NW, 3 for SE)

analysis_steps.goal: Derive excitation ratio and high-excitation gas

method.value: Compare CO(6-5) (smoothed to ATCA resolution) with CO(1-0); subtract scaled CO(1-0) model to get residuals

evidence.quote: If we subtract the model of the scaled CO(1-0) spectrum from the CO(6-5) spectrum of the central region, the CO(6-5) residuals reveal this ‘high-excitation’ gas

method.value: H2 mass from CO(6-5) via r6-5 and X_CO; dust mass from 1.2 mm flux

evidence.quote: These estimates are based on a conversion factor $X_{\rm CO}$ = M$_{\rm H_2}$/$L'_{\rm CO}$ = 0.8 M$_{\odot}$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^{2}$)$^{-1}$

assumptions.value: r6-5 = 13 (17-36 for wings), X_CO = 0.8, optically thin dust, kappa = 4.0 (nu/1.2 THz)^-2.0 cm2/g, T_dust = 45 K

method.value: Order-of-magnitude kinetic energy and Mdot = M v / R

evidence.quote: molecular gas is being redistributed at a minimum rate of Ṁ =M$_{\rm H2}$ $\times$ v$_{\rm ejecta}$ $\times$ R$^{-1}$

evidence.quote: assuming *i*$_{\rm outfl}$ = 90$^{\circ}$, M$_{\rm H_2}$ $\sim$ 10$^{10}$ M$_{\odot}$, v $\sim$ 250 km s$^{-1}$ and FWHM $\sim$ 300 km s$^{-1}$

findings_qualitative.value: Dragonfly is a precoalescent triple merger with activity triggered before the nuclei fully merged

evidence.quote: our current ALMA results indicate that the triggering of this activity has happened before the parent nuclei fully merged

findings_qualitative.value: Highest-velocity gas is also the most highly excited

evidence.quote: *This thus shows that the highest velocity gas is also the most highly excited.*

claims.hypothesis: The Dragonfly is a gas-rich merger
claims.experiment: ALMA CO(6-5) and 1.2 mm continuum compared with HST
claims.result: Double nucleus (~4 kpc) plus companion C at ~10 kpc, all with NICMOS counterparts

evidence.quote: It consists of a close double nucleus (separation $\sim$4 kpc) and a weak CO-emitter at $\sim$10 kpc distance

claims.hypothesis: Gas at highest velocities is redistributed within the merger
claims.experiment: CO(6-5) vs CO(1-0) residuals and kinematics
claims.result: ~1e10 Msun with enhanced excitation; rate >= 1200 Msun/yr
claims.finding: Gas redistribution comparable to depletion timescale; gas stays bound

evidence.quote: We estimate that the rate at which the molecular gas is redistributed is at least Ṁ $\sim$ 1200 $\pm$ 500 M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Interacting discs versus starburst/AGN-driven outflow; driver undetermined

evidence.quote: it remains unclear as to what is the total mass currently involved and what is the main driving mechanism

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution insufficient to determine disc rotation axes and properties

evidence.quote: The resolution of our CO(6-5) data is insufficient to securely determine the rotation axis and detailed properties of these putative discs

referee_caveats_inferred: Only 6.3 min on source; Gaussian decomposition degenerate
Gas masses depend on assumed r6-5 and X_CO
Outflow energetics are order-of-magnitude with assumed geometry
